mentions.name: Whenish
mentions.description: An iMessage app for coordinating group plans: users select the dates they are free, and Whenish shows the best date that works for everyone. Currently available via TestFlight.
mentions.problem: Date suggestions in group texts get lost in the mix and people forget who is available on which dates.
mentions.audience: Group texts of friends planning vacations or outings
mentions.source_excerpt:
i am building a little iMessage app called Whenish.

this was spurred from group texts with friends planning a vacation or outing. we would just throw a bunch of dates that would get lost in the mix and people would forget who was open on what dates. Whenish just allows user to select dates they are free and then it will show what is the best date that works for everyone.
